text: Healthy living means taking care of both your body and your mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and avoid too much sugar and fast food. Second, exercise regularly — even a thirty-minute walk every day makes a big difference. Good sleep is also essential, so try to go to bed and wake up at the same time. Don't forget your mental health: talk to friends, take breaks, and spend time on hobbies you enjoy. Finally, keep a healthy work-life balance by separating work from your free time. Small daily habits lead to a happier, healthier life.
